Are digivolution cards trashed when this Digimon has digivolution cards and it's moved to the breeding area using this card's effect?

Card Q&A.a:
If this Digimon is targeted by an effect and then moved to the breeding area, it remains targeted by the effect. However, it isn't affected by that effect. If it's moved back to the battle area using an effect such as [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa]'s effect, it will be affected by that effect again.

Card Q&A.a:
No, you can't. Even if a card is moved, once a [Once Per Turn] effect has activated, it can't be activated again.

Card Q&A.a:
No, it doesn't. An effect that targets this Digimon will continue targeting it even if it's moved to the breeding area, but because it isn't affected by effects while in the breeding area, it isn't returned to the hand.
